payload.title: schema_contract_agreement has only paired and skipped outcomes: a catalog entry typed with `satisfies`, a qualified or aliased JSONSchemaType, or built by a helper is dropped with no observation, so a run that pairs nothing is indistinguishable from a clean run
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/event-contracts-adapter.ts:513-542 (typedWireSchema: identifier entries only; the type comes from the variable annotation or an `as` cast; the type name is matched by getText() === 'JSONSchemaType'; every other shape returns undefined)

tools/aria-adapters/event-contracts-adapter.ts:451-462 (entries that are not plain property assignments, or have no typed schema, or whose event type has not exactly one contract site all `continue` without pushing an observation)

tools/aria-adapters/event-contracts-adapter.ts:709-720 (unwrapExpression in the same file already unwraps SatisfiesExpression for the catalog, so `satisfies` is known; the schema variable path handles only `as`)

libs/event-contracts/src/schemas/tenant-events.schema.ts:198-203 (TENANT_EVENT_SCHEMAS entries are helper calls, never paired; about 53 of the 113 catalog entries on main are spread or call forms, not identifiers)

tools/aria-adapters/event-contracts-schema-agreement.test.ts:334-362 (the near-miss scenario pins helper-call and spread entries as producing no finding, but nothing counts how many entries were paired or left unresolved)
tools/aria-adapters/event-contracts-schema-agreement.test.ts:405-438 (the real-tree scenario proves one entry, TankDeleted, is read; it cannot show that the other 59 still are)
payload.rule_violated: The RCA design for Z27 says an unmatched entry becomes an `unresolved` observation, never a silent pass; CLAUDE.md Architectural Approach tier 3 (make it detectable) for a detector that can go blind without any signal.
payload.notes: Rewriting a schema constant as `export const tankDeletedSchema = {...} satisfies JSONSchemaType<WireTankDeleted>;`, importing the type as `JSONSchemaType as JST`, or writing `Ajv.JSONSchemaType<W>` makes that entry vanish from the check: a renamed member in its Wire interface gives zero findings and the run still reports the check as executed. Reproduced by running typedWireSchema (copied verbatim from lines 504-576) on a program with each shape: annotated and `as`-cast entries were paired, `satisfies`, qualified and aliased entries were skipped with no output. The 52 helper-built event types are never paired either, and the real-repo baseline (298 observations, 0 findings) does not change when the extractor goes blind. Close condition: Emit one observation per catalog entry with its outcome (paired, or unresolved with a reason), resolve JSONSchemaType by symbol rather than by spelled text, handle `satisfies` like `as`, and pin the paired and unresolved counts of the real contracts tree in real-repo-baseline.json; a test with satisfies, qualified and aliased entries asserts they are paired or listed unresolved. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 1). Verified at head a47dc4d57c of open pull request #2134; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
